items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: me and Alan made a record, one record in my life with Sensation Rage.

ctx.x: Did you own many records? Did you own many records?

No, I didn't make, we made, me and Alan made a record, one record in my life with Sensation Rage. We made that in a house. We closed the house up and put a blank record on. We made that record. But outside of that, I never made no records anymore.
